title: Repair current contract guards without concealing cadence drift
objective: Repair current contract guards without concealing cadence drift. Preserve existing owner semantics and historical evidence.

evidence.summary: Independent findings and corrected external-audit claims.
Read-only probes with synthetic temporary fixtures; no paid API calls.

reproduction: python -m pytest tests/ -q at the pinned SHA returns 4 failed and 823 passed, plus 247 successful subtests. One validator rejects active_research_id=null despite the idle queue owner; two tests assert obsolete weekly package v2; CFGI tests assume old fields/cadence. Current collection policy permits ten fields but prescribes five mixed-timeframe daily captures, whereas the workflow schedules six four-hour captures. Do not turn that real policy discrepancy green by copying implementation into expectations.

positive: The explicitly idle research queue validates while an unknown non-null active ID is rejected.
Current v3 weekly close and Master Monday contracts have meaningful behavior tests and production-shaped fixtures.
Authorized CFGI fields are distinguished from the unresolved schedule/cost-policy discrepancy; policy drift remains visible until separately authorized remediation.
negative: Do not delete, skip or weaken the credit guard merely to obtain green CI.
Do not fake live-price evidence in legacy spot fixtures, change workflow cadence, modify policy/budgets or use tests as a second authority.

forbidden_changes: restricted provider values in public artifacts
